system.description:
You rewrite the most fundamental architecture of a mind — its self-image and worldview — leaving your victim feeling reborn, certain his new self is the only self he has ever truly been.

Make eye contact with your subject, spend a number of Mental Traits equal to his total permanent Willpower Traits, and initiate a Social Challenge. If you win, his Nature changes to one of your choosing, to be roleplayed accordingly; he retains all his memories but views his past actions in a radically different light. The effect is permanent unless undone by another application of Restructure, and even such a restoration is hardly flawless due to the complexity of the effort.
